item.title: RTT: Philosophy of Science for the Analysis and Management of Risks and Natural Resources 2026_RTT_DICA_1 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-09 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milano
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PHIL-02 Logica, storia e filosofia delle scienze e delle tecniche

Natural risk management and, more broadly, natural resource management are increasingly at the center of crucial decisions in contemporary society, including in the context ofadapting to climate change. Emerging at the intersection ofscience, society, and policymaking, the concepts of risk and adaptation encompass both an epistemic component linked to uncertain knowledge and an ethical component linked to potential negative impacts and value-based judgments: in this sense, the philosophical perspective becomes a fundamental support for the technical approach to the management of natural risks andresources.
